## Objectives {#objectives}

By the end of this session you can:

- Explain what a repository and a commit are, and what problem they
  solve.
- Clone, stage, commit, and push from your own machine.
- Read a diff before committing it.
- Explain what your browser uploads have been doing all along.

## What we cover {#coverage}

- The reveal: you have been committing through the browser for three
  weeks — here is what that meant.
- Clone / stage / commit / push / pull, in the RStudio git pane or
  GitHub Desktop (command line optional).
- Reading your own diff.
- From HW4 on, homework flows through git proper.

**Verification habit.** Read your own diff before every commit.
